_meta.what: Pro benchmark: published MLB Pipeline 20-80 grades + short verbatim scouting excerpts for college draftees, 2024-2026 drafts.
_meta.selection: From each MLB Pipeline Draft Top 250 list (2024, 2025, 2026), keep players with a college listed; sample 16 pitchers and 16 position players per year with random.Random(20261112).
_meta.grades: Copied exactly from the 'Scouting grades:' line. Tools absent from the line are absent here (not zero).
_meta.note_for_app: Position + 'college.' + the verbatim excerpt with the player's first/last name replaced by [Player]. Only modification: the redaction. Purpose: reduce the chance the model recalls the published grade from the name.
_meta.terms: See README.md: MLB.com Terms of Use restrict reproduction and automated collection. Personal, non-commercial academic evaluation; short excerpts only. Jake should decide whether excerpts go in a public repo.
_meta.public_copy: MLB Pipeline text removed; full text kept locally (gitignored).
